text:
Priya (Partnerships): Heads up - ACME Cloud marketplace PO is stuck. Portal rejected the PO with an error about missing EDA certification / EIN verification after we submitted. Putting details here so we can escalate.
Alex (Sales Ops): Ugh. Can you paste the portal error? Is this the PO that we uploaded via the XML feed or the manual portal flow? :eyes:
Priya (Partnerships): manual portal flow. Error modal said: `PO rejected: seller_ein_verification_required (eda_cert_missing)`. Screenshot: https://acme.example.com/portal/error/3942
Sam (Finance): FYI finance needs the exact field name we should populate in our billing system. Is `seller_ein` the right mapping or do they want a cert upload step?
Priya (Partnerships): Looks like they want a cert upload tied to the seller entity in their system, not just the EIN string. Their docs mention an EDA attestation PDF. I tried the upload UI but it errors out with 400. There's a small note: "certificate must be signed by accredited registrar" - maybe our reseller entity hasn't been certified.
Jordan (Legal): If this is an EDA/cert issue that's upstream of contract redlines. But if they insist on a reseller-level attestation, we might need a one-off SOW addendum to confirm entity ownership for this marketplace listing. Can you capture the exact portal text and any IDs?
Priya (Partnerships): Captured. Portal error code `eda_cert_v1:missing_doc`. I opened a ticket with ACME support (ticket #ACME-1123) and marked it P1 because it blocks PO acceptance and revenue recognition. Link: https://support.acme.example/tickets/ACME-1123
FinanceBot: PO 981234 failed validation: reason=eda_cert_v1:missing_doc, retry_count=0
Alex (Sales Ops): Thanks. Two asks: (1) Sam - can finance accept a provisional invoice if we get vendor attestation within 72h? (2) Priya - escalate to our ACME partner manager and ask for guidance on accepted registrar list.
Sam (Finance): We can approve provisional invoice only if ACME confirms receipt of the attestation and provides a provisional acceptance ID. Otherwise we can't recognize revenue.
Priya (Partnerships): On it. I pinged @lee.acme (partner manager) and asked for a tolerated workaround. Also asking partner to accept a PDF signed by our registrar (linking our KYC pack). Will update ticket with their response.
Jordan (Legal): If they require a new doc, send me a draft attestation template - I'll sign off quickly. Also note any requested redline to the terms of sale should be tracked separately; don't conflate with the PO acceptance fix.
Priya (Partnerships): Agree - keeping PO acceptance fix separate. I'll update here once ACME responds. Current plan: (a) escalate to partner manager (done), (b) attach KYC/attestation, (c) request provisional acceptance ID for finance, (d) if they demand contract changes, route to legal. ETA: 24-48h.
Alex (Sales Ops): Great. Marking as escalated in the deal desk tracker: https://rwd.in/dev/marketplace-dealdesk/rows/12345 - status = "awaiting partner attestation" :white_check_mark:
Priya (Partnerships): Added ACME ticket link to the tracker and CC'd finance/legal. Will follow up in 2 hours if no reply.
Priya (Partnerships): UPDATE 24m - ACME partner manager replied: they accepted PDF attestation from our registrar for interim acceptance. They asked to submit via portal API with `cert_type=interim` and include `partner_acceptance_id` header. Trying API now.
FinanceBot: PO 981234 status changed -> pending_partner_acceptance
Sam (Finance): If API submission succeeds and ACME returns an acceptance ID, finance will process provisional invoice. Keep me looped.
Priya (Partnerships): API call returned 200 and partner_acceptance_id=ACME-PA-778. I attached that to the dealdesk row and to the support ticket.
Alex (Sales Ops): :tada: Nice. Closing the blocker in the tracker and marking notes for future: include EDA attestation in onboarding checklist for ACME marketplace listings.
Priya (Partnerships): Adding checklist item now. Closing thread when finance confirms invoice processing.
Sam (Finance): Confirmed - proceeding with provisional invoice processing. Will move to recognized once final attestation is validated by ACME within 7 days.
Priya (Partnerships): Thanks team.
